explain_task.question: Using the revised LP relaxation diagnostics and the integer solution, explain why `q_2_0`/`y_2` (Casual Cloth in the regular segment) replaces the original model’s mix of `x_0` and `x_2`, and identify exactly which code additions caused the objective to increase from 21500.0 to 24000.0. Your answer must name the revised variables and constraints (`q[i][seg]`, `y[i]`, `labor_capacity`, at least one of `max_reg_prod_link_2` or `min_batch_2`), trace them to the exact CSV columns/parameters (`Selling Price`, `Variable Cost`, `Labor per unit`, `available_labor`, `fixed_cost_casual_clothes`, `segment_regular_discount`, `max_prod_casual_clothes`), and interpret the LP shadow prices/slacks: why does `labor_capacity` have positive dual value while promo-cap constraints have zero dual value, and why can’t you linearly extrapolate the LP marginal values to the MIP if labor is increased by 1 unit?
